title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A classic Uruguayan dish, these beef skewers are marinated in a mix of herbs and spices, then grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of grilled vegetables or a salad for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Beef (thinly sliced)
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality cut of beef for the best results

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Extra virgin olive oil is best for this recipe

ingredients.name: Chimichurri (store-bought or homemade)
ingredients.notes: See below for homemade chimichurri recipe

ingredients.name: Skewers (wooden)
ingredients.notes: Soak skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before using

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, chimichurri, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced beef to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the beef onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a salad.
